units: metres, Blender axes at rest (Z up, face -Y); FBX export Y-up forward -Z like base_body.fbx
unityImport: Rig = Humanoid (copy avatar from base_body), Normals = Import, Blend Shape Normals = None, Read/Write on; every part FBX contains the base Armature (bone names identical) so renderers can be re-pointed at the character's bones

textureConventions.brow: RGBA 512, RGB = shading, A = coverage; multiply by browColor (hair palette)
textureConventions.lids: RGBA 512, RGB = final colour of liner/shadow/lashes, A = coverage; drawn on the eye aperture only (guard mask, never across the nose bridge)
textureConventions.lips: RGBA 512, RGB = shading, A = coverage; multiply by lipTint
textureConventions.mouthInner: RGBA 512, final colours (teeth, tongue, dark), composited over lips layer
textureConventions.stubble: RGBA 512, A = hair dots; multiply by hair colour
textureConventions.iris: RGBA 256 per eyeball (eyeball UV quadrant), RGB = shading, A = tint mask: out = rgb * lerp(1, irisColor, A); sclera/pupil/highlight A = 0
textureConventions.layerOrder: skin -> blush -> stubble -> brow -> lids -> lips -> mouthInner
textureConventions.colourSpace: PNGs hold display (sRGB) values: import as sRGB
